_comment: Each series keeps one open round (or pair). When its entry window closes, the scheduler opens the next one. Blocks: ~0.3 s on Monad testnet (1 h = 12000). Keep durationBlocks a bit below entryBlocks, so the previous position on the same market is closed before the next one opens. endAtUtc: the round always ends at this UTC time (Round of the day); entry is open until durationBlocks before it. endDow: day of week for endAtUtc (0 = Sunday). waitSettle: open the next round only after the previous one settled. jackpot: bonus starts at base, grows by step (up to max) after a round nobody won, resets after a win. ride: rollover. If a round wins, its pot moves into the next round of the series instead of a draw; the contract draws after 3 pots in a row (maxRideLegs).

rounds.description: Demo round: ETH goes up in 2 minutes. A short round to try Rounds and record a demo.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: the price 2 minutes later. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Demo round: ETH goes down in 2 minutes. A short round to try Rounds and record a demo.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: the price 2 minutes later. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Round of the day: where does ETH go by 18:00 UTC? Up side, 12x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at 18:00 UTC. Above the start price: Up win. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Round of the day: where does ETH go by 18:00 UTC? Down side, 12x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at 18:00 UTC. Below the start price: Down win. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Rollover: SOL goes up in 15 minutes. If it does, the prize pool rolls into the next round and trades again, up to 3 rounds in a row. Then the big pool is drawn.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Above the start price: up wins. A win rolls the pool into the next round (rounds 1 and 2) or draws it (round 3). Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Quick round: ZEC goes down in 15 minutes. The prize pool trades a 5x ZEC short on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Below the start price: down wins. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: BTC in the next 6 hours: up or down? Pick a side. Up side, 15x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Above the start price: up wins. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: BTC in the next 6 hours: up or down? Pick a side. Down side, 15x on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Below the start price: down wins. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Steady: Monad goes up over the next day. The prize pool trades a 3x MON long on Perpl.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: price at the end. Above the start price: up wins. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Jackpot of the week: ETH by Sunday 20:00 UTC. Up side.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes (Sunday 19:00 UTC). Final: price at Sunday 20:00 UTC. Your side right: three players share the jackpot (80/15/5). Nobody wins: the jackpot grows by 50 USD next week. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Jackpot of the week: ETH by Sunday 20:00 UTC. Down side.
rounds.rules: Start price: Perpl price when entry closes (Sunday 19:00 UTC). Final: price at Sunday 20:00 UTC. Your side right: three players share the jackpot (80/15/5). Nobody wins: the jackpot grows by 50 USD next week. Your money always comes back.

rounds.description: Month round: SOL goes down in 30 days? Entry is open for a day, then the round runs for a month. The longer it runs, the more interest goes into the prize.
rounds.rules: Start price: the Perpl price when entry closes. Final: the price 30 days later. Below the start price: down wins. Your money always comes back.
